title: JEB Little Creek Cove Marina
specs: Located less than 3 miles from Chesapeake Bay Bridge Tunnel
No Wake Zone in entire harbor
Onsite bait, tackle, and marine supply store
Military/DOW ID, proof of insurance, boat registration or Coast Guard documentation, Coast Guard Vessel Safety Inspection, and current credit card required for slip contract
State boating safety certificate required for boat rental
Active Duty receive wait list priority for wet slips and storage

blurb: Cove Marina offers boat ramp access, wet slip rentals, boat rentals, and vehicle/trailer storage. It serves active duty, retired military, qualifying veterans, and DOW personnel. Amenities include bait and tackle store, pump-out dock, wash-down area, fishing areas, bath houses, and fish weigh station.
extraNote: Boat ramp passes prorated starting in April · Patrons must sign out each time they use the boat ramp · Boat rental reservations require full payment up front and can be made up to 30 days prior · Boat rental cancellation notice must be at least 48 hours prior for refund · Rentals should be refueled and cleaned before return or fees apply · Wet slip contracts must be renewed annually and information kept up to date · Cove Marina store for boat ramp sign out and rentals
